items.title: Step 3.5 Flash – Open-source foundation model, supports deep reasoning at speed
items.title_zh: Step 3.5 Flash：支持高速深度推理的开源基础模型
items.summary: StepFun describes Step 3.5 Flash as its most capable open-source foundation model, built on a sparse mixture-of-experts design that activates 11B of 196B parameters per token. The company says it targets frontier reasoning and agentic capabilities while remaining efficient enough for real-time interaction.

items.title: FAMOSE: A ReAct Approach to Automated Feature Discovery
items.title_zh: FAMOSE：面向自动化特征发现的 ReAct 方法
items.summary: FAMOSE applies the ReAct paradigm to automated feature engineering, using an agent to explore, generate and refine features while integrating selection and evaluation tools. It reports near-state-of-the-art classification results, a 0.23% average ROC-AUC gain on tasks with more than 10K instances, and a 2.0% average RMSE reduction on regression, while remaining more robust to errors.

items.title: MultiVer: Zero-Shot Multi-Agent Vulnerability Detection
items.title_zh: MultiVer：零样本多智能体漏洞检测
items.summary: MultiVer is a zero-shot multi-agent vulnerability detector whose four-agent ensemble (security, correctness, performance and style) uses union voting. It reaches 82.7% recall on PyVul, above fine-tuned GPT-3.5 at 81.3%, and 91.7% on SecurityEval, though precision falls to 48.8% and F1 to 61.4%.

items.title: Ontology-Guided Neuro-Symbolic Inference: Grounding Language Models with Mathematical Domain Knowledge
items.title_zh: 本体引导的神经符号推理：以数学领域知识为语言模型提供依据
items.summary: Implements a neuro-symbolic pipeline that uses the OpenMath ontology with hybrid retrieval and cross-encoder reranking to inject relevant definitions into prompts, evaluated on the MATH benchmark with three open-source models. Ontology-guided context improves performance when retrieval quality is high, while irrelevant context actively degrades it.

items.title: Unmasking the Factual-Conceptual Gap in Persian Language Models
items.title_zh: 揭示波斯语模型中的事实-概念差距
items.summary: DivanBench is a diagnostic benchmark of 315 questions across factual retrieval, paired scenario verification and situational reasoning, testing seven Persian LLMs on superstitions and customs. It finds severe acquiescence bias, continuous Persian pretraining amplifying that bias rather than improving reasoning, and a 21% performance gap between retrieving cultural facts and applying them in scenarios.

items.title: Catastrophic Forgetting Resilient One-Shot Incremental Federated Learning
items.title_zh: 抗灾难性遗忘的单轮增量联邦学习
items.summary: OSI-FL is a one-shot incremental federated learning framework that sends category-specific embeddings from a frozen vision-language model in a single communication round, then uses a pretrained diffusion model at the server to synthesize client-like data. Selective Sample Retention keeps the most informative samples per category and task to bound forgetting, and the method outperforms traditional and one-shot federated baselines in class- and domain-incremental settings.

items.title: MantisV2: Closing the Zero-Shot Gap in Time Series Classification with Synthetic Data and Test-Time Strategies
items.title_zh: MantisV2：用合成数据与测试时策略弥合时间序列分类的零样本差距
items.summary: Mantis+ is pretrained entirely on synthetic time series, MantisV2 is a refined, lighter encoder, and an enhanced test-time methodology leverages intermediate-layer representations with self-ensembling and cross-model embedding fusion. Across UCR, UEA, human activity recognition and EEG benchmarks the approach reports state-of-the-art zero-shot performance.

items.title: ADAPT: Hybrid Prompt Optimization for LLM Feature Visualization
items.title_zh: ADAPT：面向 LLM 特征可视化的混合提示优化
items.summary: ADAPT combines beam-search initialization with adaptive gradient-guided mutation to find inputs that strongly activate directions in LLM activation space, evaluated on Sparse Autoencoder latents from Gemma 2 2B. It proposes metrics grounded in dataset activation statistics and consistently outperforms prior feature-visualization methods across layers and latent types.

items.title: lahfir/agent-desktop
items.title_zh: agent-desktop：让智能体可靠操作桌面应用
items.summary: Agent Desktop is a Rust tool that gives agents reliable desktop computer use by reading any application's real UI structure through OS accessibility trees, so references stay stable and actions remain safe to retry instead of relying on pixel guessing.

items.title: kenn-io/agentsview
items.title_zh: agentsview：编码智能体会话的本地搜索与分析工具
items.summary: agentsview is a local-first Go tool for searching coding-agent sessions and viewing analytics, insights and token-use statistics, with support for Claude Code, Codex and more than 50 other agents.

items.title: Leonxlnx/taste-skill
items.title_zh: taste-skill：为编码智能体培养审美能力的技能集
items.summary: taste-skill is a JavaScript set of agent skills that gives coding agents art direction, reference images and a browser check, aiming to avoid generic AI-generated pages.

items.title: The Cost of Overthinking: Why Reasoning Models Fail at Document Parsing
items.title_zh: 过度思考的代价：推理模型为何在文档解析上失败
items.summary: A LlamaIndex product post examines why reasoning models can fail at document parsing, framing the problem as a cost of overthinking.
